"""Generate the 20-frame RGB video described in prompt.txt.

The prompt specifies a locked-off single shot with a fixed frame, constant
framerate, and a stationary setup (beverage dispenser on a woven basket,
half-filled glass, bright red liquid). There is no motion, so every frame
reproduces first_frame.png exactly. Frame 00 is therefore pixel-identical
to the provided first frame.
"""
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

import artifact_io


CASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
N_FRAMES = 20


def main() -> None:
    first = np.array(Image.open(CASE_DIR / "first_frame.png").convert("RGB"))
    # Static scene: hold the identical frame across the whole 5-second clip.
    frames = np.broadcast_to(first, (N_FRAMES,) + first.shape).copy()
    artifact_io.save(frames, CASE_DIR)
    print(f"saved {frames.shape[0]} frames of shape {frames.shape[1:]}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
